svg.aria-label: Deadline budget propagation: the inbound gRPC deadline is spent across every hop — connection checkout, PostgreSQL statement_timeout derived from time remaining, and the outbound tax-service call — failing fast when the budget is exhausted

text.style: font: italic 700 11px -apple-system, system-ui, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; fill: #444;

svg.text: External hops — each re-derives its own slice of the budget
